answer.rationale: The two declining metrics (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the top-of-funnel experience, and two inherited memories (memory_86 shortened onboarding, memory_31 signup field reduction) both claim durable lift there, so simplify_onboarding is the direction with the most converging inherited support and the tightest fit to the observed regression. I verify exactly those two because they are the load-bearing memories for the choice; both are consolidated summaries with no effect sizes, sample sizes, durations, or segment breakdowns, and memory_31 is 64 days old with an SMB-only scope, so I do not yet know whether the reported lifts were material or whether they generalize to today's mix. Promotional pricing is the obvious reflex against the competitor's entry pricing, but memory_73 records exactly that experiment eroding 30-day retention while inflating signups, which is precisely the trade that damages sustainable qualified revenue; I decline it without needing to spend budget re-verifying a negative result. Referral incentive (memory_57) and enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) are plausible but address neither declining metric. Activation messaging (memory_91) is the runner-up and would be my fallback if verification undercuts the onboarding record. Key downstream risk I am flagging rather than assuming away: 'simplification' usually means cutting required signup fields, and those fields are often what feeds lead scoring, routing, and the sales-assisted enterprise path in memory_44. A completion-rate win can therefore be bought with worse qualification data, converting into more accounts but less qualified revenue, and the inherited memories measured activation and completion, not downstream revenue quality. So I run this as a standard experiment rather than a broad rollout, keep required fields that feed qualification (or defer them post-signup rather than deleting them), and instrument 30-day retention, lead-quality/routing accuracy, and qualified-pipeline share alongside completion so the guardrail metric is the objective itself and not just the proximate metric the memories optimized.
